entities.summary: Iglesia de Santa María  is a church in Asturias, Spain. It was built in the 18th century and is located in the municipality of Cudillero, in the principality of Asturias (Spain). Together with the Rectory House, it forms an old pilgrim’s hospital connected to the Camino de Santiago.
